title: PWR-A skeleton probe: the 24 anchored refs and the scripted copper of the draft only
note: W2 PCB-PWRA-1 probe for one CI route run: loads the 4-layer PWR_A.kicad_pro in KiCad 10.0.7, places the anchors of build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/PWR_A.spec-draft.json and lays its scripted copper, so that the anchors, the locked copper and the pour necks can be measured on a saved board. It covers 24 of the 256 PWR_A refs, so the domain and boundary audits fail by construction; removed from pcb/boards/ right after the run.

layers.source: build/15 'Шари' and 'Мідь і струмові класи (W2 PCB-RULES)': JLC04161H-7628, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, no 2 oz

plan.F.Cu: L1: parts, signals; BATT/PWR3A pours (scripted where both ends are anchored)
plan.In1.Cu: L2: solid GND (post-route pour over the whole outline)
plan.B.Cu: L4: signals; BATT/PWR3A pours paired with L1; GND bond copper in the four thermal_bond zones, solder mask on

rules_note: board_gen refuses rules_file until it copies and hashes it (PCB-FAB/PCB-SB1 lineage), so the net classes and project rules of pcb/rules/jlc-4l-1oz.kicad_dru and pcb/generated/netclasses.json are mirrored in PWR_A.kicad_pro: classes SIG (Default) 0.15, PWR1A 0.35, PWR2A 0.8, PWR3A 1.85, BATT 3.2 mm outer, clearance 0.15; via 0.6/0.3; min through hole 0.2 because the KiCad LT3045 footprint MSOP-12-1EP ThermalVias drills 0.2 mm (JLC 4-layer floor 0.15)

fab_floor.source: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities read 2026-11-07 (W2 PCB-PWRA-1), multilayer 1 oz values; the same numbers as pcb/generated/netclasses.json fab_floor.jlc_4l_1oz

tracks.why: scripted locked link C113.1 -> R110.2 of the LAB5 RC damper (PWR3A class 1.85 mm, netclasses.json)

zones.why: BATT class (3.2 mm single layer, 1.85 mm per layer on L1 + L4): U108 VOUT -> F102.1, paired with LAB5-RAW-B; the THT pins of U108 and F102 join the two layers

split_nets_note: pcb/check_boards.py split_nets: a BATT/PWR3A net poured on L1 and L4 is checked against the per-layer split width (netclasses.json split_outer_per_layer_mm) when both layers join the same THT pads

height_zones.why: parts taller than hA 4.5 need a PWR-B window (pcb/partition-spec.json height_rule); the window list of this placement is in placement-study.json pwr_b_cutouts
